{"text": "The function `showhelp` is a utility within the pytest framework that displays comprehensive help information to users.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` takes a single parameter, `config`, which is an instance of the `Config` class representing the current pytest configuration.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` retrieves a `TerminalReporter` plugin from the configuration's plugin manager.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` writes help information for command-line options using the `format_help` method of the `_parser.optparser`.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` lists ini-options found in configuration files such as `pytest.ini`, `tox.ini`, `setup.cfg`, or `pyproject.toml`.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "For each ini-option, the function `showhelp` extracts the help text, type, and default value.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` raises a `TypeError` if the help text is missing for any ini-option.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` displays environment variables that can influence pytest's behavior, along with brief descriptions of their effects.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` concludes by suggesting commands to list available markers and fixtures, explaining how these are displayed based on the current directory or specified file.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` uses methods such as `write` and `line` from the `TerminalReporter` and text wrapping utilities from the `textwrap` module to format output.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `showhelp` performs no error handling for edge cases beyond raising exceptions for missing help texts.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The side effects of the function `showhelp` are limited to outputting formatted text to the terminal, with no changes made to the configuration or application state.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
